name: Brindle 6: Create Spreadsheet
description: Business MCP server (project 13): run once to create the Google Sheet the MCP tools read and write.

parameters.jsCode:
const c = $('Create Spreadsheet').first().json;
return [{ json: { spreadsheetId: c.spreadsheetId, url: c.spreadsheetUrl, next: 'Put the ID in workflows/config.json (SHEET_ID), rebuild and deploy, then run Brindle 5: Reset Demo.' } }];

parameters.content:
## Brindle 6: Create Spreadsheet
Run once when setting up. Creates the Google Sheet the MCP servers read and write (Settings, Team, Clients, Projects, Tasks, Time, Invoices, Audit) with bold, frozen header rows. A real studio would point the tools at its own sheet, or swap Load Data for its project-management and accounting APIs; the tools stay the same.
